about: The Workbench icons of the Descent2 drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons-d2x/icons.json --out amiga/icons-d2x (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is D2X-Rebirth's own program icon (d2x-rebirth/d2x-rebirth.png). Descent2-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Descent2.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Descent2.info.
